text: In the far north of Norway stood a village called Husk.
Every autumn, the whole village came together to bring in the harvest before the snow.
Alice was nine years old.
High above the village was a cave, and in that cave lived dragons.
Earth, water, stone, crystal, light.
And last of all, the king of them all: fire.
Alice had never seen a dragon.
She wanted to, more than anything.
Every year, some of the harvest went to the forest spirits.
The most important of these were the pandas.
While most pandas were reserved and serene, Po was shy.
Too shy even to join the festivities.
Which is kind of why Alice liked him best.
[shouting, urgent] The dragons are coming!
The whole village stopped.
Then it ran.
Everyone ran for home, and Alice ran the other way.
[breathless, excited] Po!
Can you take me in the sky to see the dragons?
[alarmed] Are you crazy?
You're going to get eaten by them.
Alice thought for a moment.
[sly] If you take me, I'll give you extra juicy bamboo.
[reluctant] I'll take you.
But only if you keep this sword with you.
Just in case.
So Alice climbed on.
And they flew.
